title: Restricted affine-max empirical consistency
statement: For a compact finite-capacity affine-max class with uniform cell-mass and conditioning margins and appropriate score integrability, cell moments converge uniformly; objective values converge uniformly; approximate empirical maximizers are value-consistent, and isolated population optima give decision/parameter consistency up to labels.
assumptions: required information eigenvalues bounded away from zero
bounded scores or suitable uniform integrability
warning: The unrestricted/global consistency problem remains open.
